entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, you can help me by explaining why you sent me this absolute garbage. I ordered a jersey and it's completely the wrong size! This is unacceptable!

I'm very sorry to hear that you're unhappy with the fit. I can definitely help you with this. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?
A preference? Are you kidding me? It's too tight! I can barely breathe in this thing! I'm a VIP member, for crying out loud. I expect better than this. Get me your manager, now!

I understand your frustration completely, and I sincerely apologize that the sizing wasn't right for you. I can see your VIP status here, and we truly value your business. I assure you, there's no need for a manager; I'm empowered to resolve this for you right now.
Oh, you're 'empowered,' are you? Fine. Then fix it. I want my money back, and I'm not paying to ship this thing back to you. I swear, I'm about to light you up on every review site on the internet.

I can absolutely fix this. Looking at your order, I see you received the jersey just three days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window. We can process a full refund or an exchange for a different size, and the return shipping is always on us. Which would you prefer?
An exchange? No, I'm done. I want a refund. But this whole experience has been a complete waste of my time. You think a refund makes up for this hassle?

You're right, and I want to make it right. I have just emailed you a pre-paid return label for the jersey. And for the inconvenience this has caused, and as a thank you for being a valued VIP member, I've also added a $25 store credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase.
Wait, really? You're just... adding a $25 credit?

Yes, sir. It's already active on your account. We want to ensure you have a positive experience with us, even when a product doesn't work out. Once we receive the original jersey back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed immediately.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... actually very helpful. Thank you, Isaac. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly.
Of course. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
